Entries.Title: The Dark Knight
Entries.Description: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

Entries.Title: Moana 2
Entries.Description: After receiving an unexpected call from her wayfinding ancestors, Moana journeys alongside Maui and a new crew to the far seas of Oceania and into dangerous, long-lost waters for an adventure unlike anything she's ever faced.

Entries.Title: The Green Dinosaur
Entries.Description: When the world around him is mysteriously erased, a little green dinosaur named Diplodocus must travel through the pages of a comic book and adventure through time to bring color back to his land. Alongside a wizard and two scientists, Diplo’s plans go awry as he learns that there may be a dimension to his world that he never considered.

Entries.Title: Night
Entries.Description: Night has to trick the mother of the missing child into sleeping to save her soul.

Entries.Title: SuperKlaus
Entries.Description: Santa Claus's wish comes true when he accidentally bumps his head and starts believing he's SuperKlaus. With the help of Billie and Leo his elf-xecutive assistant, SuperKlaus will take on a toy-obsessed businessman to save Christmas.

Entries.Title: Inside Out 2
Entries.Description: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

Entries.Title: Kaiju No. 8
Entries.Description: In a world plagued by creatures known as Kaiju, Kafka Hibino aspired to enlist in The Defense Force. He makes a promise to enlist with his childhood friend, Mina Ashiro. Soon, life takes them in separate ways. While employed cleaning up after Kaiju battles, Kafka meets Reno Ichikawa. Reno's determination to join The Defense Force reawakens Kafka's promise to join Mina and protect humanity.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Became a Kaiju
Episodes.Description: Kafka Hibino has almost abandoned his dream of joining the anti-Kaiju "Defense Force." He now works in Kaiju clean-up, disposing of the bodies of slain Kaiju and thinking back with regret to the days he spent with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, captain of Defense Force's Third Division.

Episodes.Title: The Kaiju Who Defeats Kaiju
Episodes.Description: After turning into a Kaiju, Kafka is forced to flee. His escape is interrupted, however, by the arrival of another Kaiju...

Episodes.Title: Revenge Match
Episodes.Description: Kafka arrives for one last shot at the Defense Force entry exam... but can he pass while keeping his Kaiju powers a secret?

Episodes.Title: Fortitude 9.8
Episodes.Description: An unexpected incident during the exam forces Kafka to use his powers at the risk of revealing his secret.

Episodes.Title: Joining Up!
Episodes.Description: Kafka is now a member of the Defense Force, if not a full-fledged one. But Hoshina tells him he has three months to prove himself before he's fired...

Episodes.Title: Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak
Episodes.Description: It's time for Kafka's first mission, and he witnesses the true power of the Defense Force when a Kaiju strikes a nearby city.

Episodes.Title: Kaiju No. 9
Episodes.Description: Reno and Iharu encounter a powerful humanoid Kaiju that quickly overwhelms them. Can help arrive in time?

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Defense Force
Episodes.Description: After transforming into a Kaiju to rescue Reno and Iharu, Kafka is found by Hoshina, who immediately attacks him.

Episodes.Title: Raid on Tachikawa Base
Episodes.Description: Tachikawa base comes under attack from the air, as a powerful Kaiju has its sights set on the Defense Force.

Episodes.Title: Secret Revealed
Episodes.Description: When the Defense Force is in danger, Kafka is forced to choose between keeping his secret and saving his comrades.

Episodes.Title: Kaiju No. 8 Captured
Episodes.Description: Kaiju No. 8 is captured, and Kafka is at the mercy of the Defense Force's most important leaders.

Episodes.Title: Kafka Hibino
Episodes.Description: Kafka's final fate is determined as the monster within him tries to take control.

Episodes.Title: Kaiju Weapon
Episodes.Description: Kafka goes on a mission with his new squad and faces Kaiju No. 9 once again.

Episodes.Title: The Next Generation's Trial
Episodes.Description: A challenge begins for the next generation of the Defense Force.

Episodes.Title: The Strongest Division
Episodes.Description: Kaiju No. 9 appears for the third time, splitting in two and overwhelming the Defense Force.

Entries.Title: Dan Da Dan
Entries.Description: In a bet to prove whether ghosts or aliens exist, two high schoolers face terrifying paranormal threats, gain superpowers and maybe even fall in love?!

Episodes.Title: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know!
Episodes.Description: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. To make each other believe what they deny, they head to a spot famous for UFO sightings and a spiritual hotspot.

Episodes.Title: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!
Episodes.Description: Momo awakens psychic powers, while Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny. They evacuate to Momo's house, but a giant alien appears before them.

Episodes.Title: It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!
Episodes.Description: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.

Episodes.Title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass
Episodes.Description: Okarun and Momo arrive at the tunnel to confront Turbo Granny. Just when they think they've won, a giant crab spirit crashes through the wall.

Episodes.Title: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
Episodes.Description: Momo and Okarun’s ordeal with Turbo Granny has brought them closer, but things remain awkward between them. Okarun realizes he still has a problem.

Episodes.Title: A Dangerous Woman Arrives
Episodes.Description: Turbo Granny reveals that Okarun's missing organs are contained within golden spheres. Aira, who has found one, now has the ability to see spirits.

Episodes.Title: To a Kinder World
Episodes.Description: Momo and Okarun manage to weaken Acrobatic Silky but make a shocking discovery regarding Aira. Acrobatic Silky suggests a surprising way to help.

Episodes.Title: I've Got This Funny Feeling
Episodes.Description: Aira begins to develop a crush on Okarun. As the three friends' emotions intertwine, they suddenly face another extraterrestrial emergency.

Episodes.Title: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
Episodes.Description: Wielding Acrobatic Silky's power, Aira fights the Serpoians alongside Okarun and Momo. The frustrated Serpoians power up their crustacean-like minion.

Episodes.Title: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
Episodes.Description: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. Later, the aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

Episodes.Title: First Love
Episodes.Description: Momo's childhood friend Jiji has come to stay with the Ayases. He explains that he needs Seiko’s help with some strange phenomena at his house.

Episodes.Title: Let's Go to the Cursed House
Episodes.Description: On the way to investigate the Enjoji house, Okarun feels uneasy about Jiji's closeness to Momo but finds himself drawn to his friendly nature.

Episodes.Title: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
Episodes.Description: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. Just then, the doorbell rings.

Episodes.Title: The Evil Eye
Episodes.Description: In a bid to free Okarun and Momo from the Mongolian Death Worm’s psychic power, Jiji attempts to carry them to safety but runs into a powerful entity.

Episodes.Title: You Won't Get Away with This!
Episodes.Description: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

Episodes.Title: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
Episodes.Description: Momo tries to stop the magma, but the Kito family gets in her way. The tsuchinoko shrine priest joins the fray — but so does the possessed Jiji.

Episodes.Title: We Can All Stay There Together!
Episodes.Description: With everyone safely back at Seiko's house, Momo and the others discover that water has a surprising effect on how Evil Eye possesses Jiji's body.

Entries.Title: Solo Leveling
Entries.Description: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.

Episodes.Title: I'm Used to It
Episodes.Description: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

Episodes.Title: If I Had One More Chance
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

Episodes.Title: It's Like a Game
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end—or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

Episodes.Title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
Episodes.Description: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jinwoo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

Episodes.Title: A Pretty Good Deal
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo joins a party led by Hwang Dongsuk to meet the headcount necessary for a C-Rank dungeon. Joined by another temporary hire, Yoo Jinho, the party defeats beasts without much trouble, but Jinwoo has suspicions about the group's lack of a healer.

Episodes.Title: The Real Hunt Begins
Episodes.Description: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jinwoo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

Episodes.Title: Let's See How Far I Can Go
Episodes.Description: As Jinwoo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

Episodes.Title: This Is Frustrating
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

Episodes.Title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
Episodes.Description: At the D-Rank raid, Jinwoo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Taeshik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then...

Episodes.Title: What Is This, a Picnic?
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, Jinwoo teams up with Jinho to raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention...

Episodes.Title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
Episodes.Description: Out of the blue, a "job-change quest" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, he enters the gate. Inside, he fights wave after wave of enemies, culminating in a knight who brings back memories of the Cartenon Temple.

Episodes.Title: Arise
Episodes.Description: Drained from endless battle, Jinwoo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

Episodes.Title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You
Episodes.Description: After a scheduled meeting with Jinah's teachers, Jinwoo is asked to talk to one of her classmates, Han Song-yi, who is working as a hunter. In an effort to show her the harsh reality of the job, Jinwoo takes her to a raid designated for new hunters of the White Tiger guild.

Episodes.Title: I Suppose You Aren't Aware
Episodes.Description: After being trapped inside of a red gate, Jinwoo has to contend with a bloodthirsty pack of ice elves who question his humanity.

Episodes.Title: Still a Long Way to Go
Episodes.Description: Having completed his promise to Jinho to clear 19 dungeons, Jinwoo is stronger than he was when he fought the Cerberus. In order to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life and save his mother, he once again enters the S-Rank Demon's Castle dungeon.

Episodes.Title: I Need to Stop Faking
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

Episodes.Title: This Is What We're Trained to Do
Episodes.Description: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

Episodes.Title: Don't Look Down on My Guys
Episodes.Description: The Hunters Guild strike team is confronting the high orc shaman Kargalgan when Jinwoo crashes the fight.

Episodes.Title: The 10th S-Rank Hunter
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
Episodes.Description: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: It Was All Worth It
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

Episodes.Title: We Need a Hero
Episodes.Description: Sparks fly as the S-rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid.

Episodes.Title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
Episodes.Description: As the S-Rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

Episodes.Title: Are You the King of Humans
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

Episodes.Title: On to the Next Target
Episodes.Description: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

Entries.Title: Adam's Sweet Agony
Entries.Description: This is the story of a boy, who became the lone Adam among four billion Eves. In a world where a pandemic has rendered all men impotent, high school student Itsuki is the exception who escaped it. In order to protect this secret, he transfers to a very special high school, which turns out to be composed of 90% girls! There, he encounters an upbeat and friendly senior, a sexually frustrated female teacher, a tomboyish school 'prince,' and an heiress from a wealthy family. For Itsuki, who has his pick of any woman in the world, the question remains: which one will he choose?

Entries.Title: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, the Side Character?!
Entries.Description: After finding himself reincarnated into the world of a novel, Loneal goes to great lengths to steer clear of Prince Alec, the hero, to avoid disrupting the main storyline between Alec and the heroine, Lily. However, to Loneal's great surprise, the prince becomes infatuated with...him?! "A charming physique, such as yours, more than makes up for your lack of experience." Before he knows it, he finds himself melting into the prince's arms... Why is everything so different from the novel?!

Episodes.Title: You're the One...I've Always Longed For
Episodes.Description: Following an accident, Loneal finds himself reborn as a side character in the renowned fantasy novel, 'The Silver Prince and the Holy Bride.' As a fan of the novel in his former life, Loneal is aware of the plot, and does his utmost to avoid meddling in the developing romance between the story's primary hero, Prince Alec, and the captivating heroine, Lily. However, despite Loneal's earnest attempts, he ends up in a precarious situation. Just when he braces himself for Prince Alec's condemnation, the story's hero instead confesses to Loneal, saying, "I've always wanted to touch you..." His eyes ablaze with passion!

Episodes.Title: Let's Recreate the Magic From Yesterday
Episodes.Description: As Loneal struggles to create an antidote for the love potion, Alec approaches him with a proposition for a date, both donning their royal uniforms. Stepping outside the academy, Loneal and Alec savor their time together, free from the concerns of others. Alec surprises Loneal with a thoughtful gift—a necklace—and hints at potentially calling off his engagement with Lily. The carriage ride back is uncomfortable, and when Loneal tries to express gratitude for the gift, Alec cooly responds, saying, "Why don't we pick up where we left off yesterday?"

Episodes.Title: No Matter What Secrets You May Hold...
Episodes.Description: Venturing into the forest in search of antidote ingredients, Loneal falls prey to an attack by a mysterious hooded man. Fortunately, Alec comes to his rescue just in the nick of time. However, unsettling words from the mysterious assailant suggest that, in his previous life, Loneal might have been considered an enemy of the prince. Disturbed by this revelation, Loneal realizes he has lost the necklace gifted by Alec and, amidst the pouring rain, returns to the forest alone. Loneal is discovered by the concerned Alec. In a comforting gesture, Alec tenderly embraces Loneal, bringing warmth to his chilled heart and body.

Episodes.Title: Is This Love an Illusion?
Episodes.Description: Loneal, overwhelmed by guilt for changing the course of the original story, devises a plan to set things right. His idea  involves bringing Alec and Lily closer by inviting them to a picnic in the rose garden. However, as he witnesses them together, a pang of anguish grips his heart. Alec, who has long seen through Loneal's strategy, calmly inquires about the plan. Faced with the prince's cool and composed voice, Loneal realizes he can't keep anything from the dashing Alec.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Love You, From Morning Till Night, Forever.
Episodes.Description: Loneal is caught off guard when a sudden uniform inspection is sprung on him by the disciplinary committee. Panicking at the idea of his necklace from Alec being confiscated, Loneal is in a frenzy. However, an unfamiliar junior named Zeno steps in to help! Loneal quickly connects with the friendly and sociable Zeno but Alec, unusually moody, is displeased. With a brief greeting, Alec takes Loneal's hand and leads him into an empty classroom. Why would the prince react in such a stern way?

Episodes.Title: Thank You for Teaching Me to Love
Episodes.Description: On the quest for magical potion ingredients, Loneal and Alec venture into the forest to gather medicinal herbs. However, their expedition takes a dark turn as they delve deeper into the wilderness! Lost in the forest at night, the two now face the challenge of struggling for survival. Despite Loneal feeling disheartened, Alec's comforting words provide a source of positivity. In the secluded woods, the two discover solace in each other's company...

Episodes.Title: From the Depths of Our Beings
Episodes.Description: Having barely fended off the magical beasts, Alec, who protected Loneal, ends up poisoned. Feeling particularly powerless for lacking a sacred power like Lily's, Loneal falls into despair. In that moment, Alec's sincere and clear words echo in Loneal's mind. Fueled by a strong determination, a newfound power awakens within Loneal, and he does everything in his power to save the struggling prince!

Episodes.Title: I Adore You, Loneal
Episodes.Description: After being tasked to concoct a magical potion, Loneal decides to enlist Alec's support. The potion progresses smoothly, however, an unexpected change occurs in Loneal's body! Alec's magical power flows into Loneal, as his body grows warm and a delightful feeling runs through him. Finally, the secret of the love potion is revealed ...

Entries.Title: Barangay 143
Entries.Description: Barangay 143 follows the coming of age story of a young man in search of a father and how he finds an unlikely family in a team of misfits trying to bring glory to their hometown. It's a story about love and family set against the action-packed world of street basketball, where the stakes are always high and life is the biggest game you can win.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Unstoppable
Episodes.Description: Coach B  visits the grave of his son, Basti  who was slain by a gun for hire two years before the first game of the season for Barangay 143's Basketball Team, the Puzakals. He mentioned that a new player will be coming soon to their aid. However, the Puzakals fought Barangay 369's Oso Negros without him and it resulted to failures that lead to an embarrassing loss for Barangay 143. Meanwhile Bren Park travels to the Philippines, and while on travel he reminiscence the tragedies that happened to him, especially the defeat of the Korean National Team, the death of most of the Park family due to a car accident that happened during the game due to an ongoing snowstorm, and the planned takeover of their business partners on the Park family's share on the Supermarket business.

Episodes.Title: The Truth about You
Episodes.Description: After the death of the Park family following an accident due to the Snowstorm that hit Korea during the game, Bren attended the funeral services for his family. He was also being told not only to sell his share to the supermarket business, but also to sell his insurance and the house mortgage so that he could continue his education. He was then given a last will and testament for him and for a former family employee and his former nanny, Baby Dela Cruz. Days after fixing his things and before leaving Korea, he played his last game where they were defeated by the Chinese National Team by a point, quitted the National Team, committed a suicide attempt through a vehicular accident by being hit over by a delivery van, and vowed never to play the sport.

Episodes.Title: Welcome To Korea
Episodes.Description: During the night when Bren arrived back to the Philippines, Barangay 38's Green Monkeys had a practice for an upcoming match. Danny "Dandoy" Chan watched the practice and gave a lollipop to the Coach's daughter, Letty. Dandoy then revealed his intention in making the team subscribe again to Match fixing for its upcoming, game and their Coach commanded the captain that the training is already finished and to take his daughter to school and rejects the proposal.

Episodes.Title: Korean Tapsi
Episodes.Description: Bren asked Buchoy to go where Vicky went which is the Barangay's Basketball Arena. They met again each on which Vicky owed Bren an explanation on which Buchoy mistakenly interpreted as a lover's quarrel yet at the end of the day, Bren was frustrated did not got an answer from Vicky. This prompted Buchoy to play with him Basketball in a vacant lot which he rejected. Meanwhile, Coach B meets Detective Ramirez and discussed about a syndicate's involvement on his son's death and that person involved was revealed as Danny "Dandoy" Chan, a Chinese Filipino who barely speak Philippine Hokkien well.

Episodes.Title: Women's Basketball Tryout
Episodes.Description: Bren is still hoping to find his real father and his new lead is promising but with an unpleasant twist. Vicky and Bren fights in front of the team and when things got out of control, Bren ends up saying foul remarks about her.

Episodes.Title: Vicky, Can We?
Episodes.Description: Wax and Vicky bonds while talking about Basti’s birthday. Kpop says sorry to Vicky with the help of Buchoy and the Puzakals team. James tells Bren that Melvin is not his biological father.

Episodes.Title: Look, A Shooting Star!
Episodes.Description: Vicky reminds Bren that he has a purpose in Barangay 143 when he is being dubious. Meanwhile, the team of Coach Jimmy - Green Monkey’s serves as the PIBA’s dark horse for the season which highly threatens the Blue Valley Lions. With Vicky being close to Bren and the Blue Valley Lions losing to Green Monkey’s, how would this affect Wax?

Episodes.Title: No Harm! No Foul!
Episodes.Description: What makes Vicky and Wax closer is their love for the late Basti Sebastian. But with Bren in the picture and the strong dislike the Puzakal boys have for Wax, can their relationship be more than friends? Meanwhile, someone from Bren’s past is coming to Tondo!

Episodes.Title: She's Just My Friend
Episodes.Description: Vicky is in denial of her jealousy towards the visitor of Bren - his ex, Jinri. Wax is to the rescue! He low-key sets up a date with Vicky. Will he take the chance to tell her what he really feels?

Episodes.Title: There's No Forever
Episodes.Description: As the Puzakals climb their way up to the top, Vicky and Bren’s chance on love is slimming because of the arrival of Jinri and the recent confession of Wax. Meanwhile, Wax would know a secret that might change his life forever. Would this secret affect his blossoming closeness with Vicky?

Episodes.Title: Just Call Me Miguel
Episodes.Description: Yumi - Mom of Bren, is craving for freedom and adventure. This leads her to deciding recklessly and leaving everything behind to chase liberation. She will meet Jack Rivera - will their kindred spirit spark something else more than friendship?

Episodes.Title: I Really Love You...
Episodes.Description: The highlight of Yumi’s vacation in the Philippines is meeting the star player Jack Rivera. She goes home to Korea with a heavy heart because of how they ended up things. But, she is not expecting that things will be more difficult for her back home as a consequence of her unwise decisions.
